case.title: The Hotel Affair
case.introduction: Tonight at The Meridian Grand Hotel, the poisoning of the guest of honour has thrown the evening into chaos. No one may leave. 6 guests remain — each with something to hide. One of them is not who they claim to be. Find them.
case.crime: The poisoning of the guest of honour
case.escape_plan: Emma Okafor intends to slip out during the confusion and vanish before the authorities arrive.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Bookshelves, a heavy desk, a locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Night air, hedges, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Quarters
rooms.description: A corridor of numbered doors, most left ajar.

timeline.description: The incident: the poisoning of the guest of honour.
Alarm raised; the site is sealed.
Emma Okafor is seen slipping toward an exit.

evidence.name: muddy shoes
evidence.description: Expensive shoes caked with garden mud, though it hasn't rained inside.

evidence.name: a wine glass
evidence.description: A half-full glass with a faint bitter residue.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped beneath a drawer.

evidence.name: a photograph
evidence.description: A candid photo of two guests who claim never to have met.

evidence.name: a forged passport
evidence.description: A convincing passport with a subtly wrong birth year.

evidence.name: a bloodstained handkerchief
evidence.description: Fine linen with a monogram and a dark stain.

evidence.name: a burner phone
evidence.description: A cheap phone with a single dialled number.

hidden_clues: Emma Okafor's account of their whereabouts conflicts with the muddy shoes.
Two guests deny a relationship that a photograph proves.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted operative posing as criminologist
solution.reasoning: Emma Okafor is the hidden target: the key evidence (muddy shoes, a threatening note) places them at the scene and contradicts their alibi, while their documents are forged.

state.current_objective: Identify the hidden target among the suspects.
